```{r}
readtest <- read.csv("history.csv")
View(readtest)
readtest2 <- read.csv("regional-global-weekly-2016-12-30--2017-01-06.csv")
View(readtest2)
readtest2_2 <- readtest2
View(readtest2_2)
names(readtest2_2) <- c("Position", "Track Name", "Artist", "Streams", "URL")
readtest2_2$Streams <- as.double(readtest2_2$Streams)

for (bonk in c(1:(length(readtest2_2$Position)-1))) {
  readtest2_2[bonk,] <- readtest2_2[bonk+1,]
}
readtest2_2 <- readtest2_2[-201,]
```
